stumbles.quote: Lock screen rotation in portrait. The game asks for landscape itself and shows a prompt when it is time to turn the phone, so automatic rotation would get in the way.
stumbles.why: Seems contradictory: you lock portrait, yet are told to turn the phone to landscape. It's unclear how the game gets landscape if rotation is locked, or what turning the phone does.

stumbles.quote: when the start lights go out
stumbles.why: Start lights are never introduced. It's unclear when they appear or how they relate to the 'prompt'. The calibration moment is also unclear: is it when the prompt appears or when the lights go out?

stumbles.quote: When the prompt appears, turn the phone to landscape
stumbles.why: Which prompt this is, and when it appears, are not stated. The options screen is described, but nothing says how you start the race or when the prompt shows.
Options Laps and Difficulty have no listed values, unlike Track, so you can't tell what to choose.
These track names are not explained. This is minor, but it's unclear whether they differ in a way that matters.

stumbles.quote: Top of the phone away from you
stumbles.why: Ambiguous in landscape: which edge is the top, and which landscape orientation (which way to turn) is expected.
The controls give no neutral state between accelerate and brake. It's unclear whether neutral means coasting, and it's not stated whether the car accelerates automatically.

point: Open the page on a motion-sensor phone, lock portrait, pick track/laps/difficulty, then turn to landscape when prompted and hold a comfortable position, because that angle becomes neutral when the lights go out, then tilt to steer, accelerate and brake.
